    "Model forecasts are consistently 1-3 points too high compared to true outcomes",

    "Model exhibits mean reversion bias, undershooting price rebounds after declines",
    "Large forecast errors occur when model predicts continuous upward trends that encounter resistance",
    "Sentiment turning negative ( <0) signals model will lag behind rapid price corrections",
    "Underlying price volatility increases forecast error magnitude by approximately 20-30%"
